source_caption_text:
#LUCKI Speaks Out For The First Time Following The St***ing Incident Outside Of ComplexCon This Past Weekend. He’s In Good Spirits, & Is Asking LAPD For His Car Back 😳🙏

“LAPD, Can I Please Get My Car Back? I Don’t Know What Happened… I Got $100,000 In The Car, My Debit Cards.”

LUCKI, whose real name is Lucki Camel Jr., is a Chicago rapper who has become one of the most influential artists to emerge from the modern underground rap scene. Born on May 30, 1996, LUCKI began making noise as a teenager under the name Lucki Eck$, gaining early recognition with his 2013 project Alternative Trap. His laid-back delivery, atmospheric production, and brutally personal approach to music quickly separated him from many of the artists coming out of Chicago at the time.

Throughout his career, LUCKI has built an extremely loyal fanbase by consistently releasing music and developing a sound that has influenced a newer generation of underground artists. Projects including Freewave 3, Days B4 III, FLAWLESS LIKE ME, sx mney drgs*, and GEMINI! helped take his career to another level. Songs like “More Than Ever,” “New Drank,” “Super Urus,” “Y NOT?” and “Heavy On My Heart” have become fan favorites, while his music frequently touches on relationships, money, success, substance use, trust, and the realities that come with his lifestyle.

LUCKI eventually crossed over from being considered primarily an underground artist into becoming a commercially successful rapper. His 2022 album FLAWLESS LIKE ME reached No. 12 on the Billboard 200 and included appearances from Future and Babyface Ray. His rise has been especially impressive because it wasn’t built around one huge viral moment—he spent years developing his sound and fanbase before receiving wider mainstream recognition.

Most recently, LUCKI made headlines following a sting incident outside of ComplexCon*. LUCKI later spoke publicly following the incident and appeared to be in good spirits, while also asking the LAPD to return his vehicle and saying that he had money, debit cards, and other belongings inside of it.
